finding: Client wording: "a BTST algorithm" that carries positions to expiry; capital ₹2 crore; 4% carry stop and 1% expiry-day stop
Sibling Algo 7 trades the expiry day only (30,171 of 30,192 fills on D0); Algo 8 adds the day before and the overnight carry
Cycle = D-1 builds the book, D0 manages it (D0 3.6x the lots, mostly buy-backs and re-sales)
First ATM straddle at 09:16 on D-1 (31/32), strike = nearest ATM to the 09:15 close (31/31)
Protected straddles added on a ~15-minute clock (544/544 windows), common size ladder on both indices (22/22 slots)
Later straddles re-centred near the moving ATM (97% NIFTY, 95% SENSEX within one strike)
Additions fire after rises and falls, IV up and down, book in profit or loss; a falling opening candle still entered
No classical index or option indicator is identifiably used (75 + 14 measures, nested chronological models vs shuffled nulls, BH-FDR)
IV rises do not explain additions (1% of pre-expiry additions follow a 1-point IV rise)
Every addition raises theta and makes vega and gamma more negative (97-98% of windows)
Opening and overnight books are theta+, vega-, gamma- (31/31)
Routine wing = highest OTM premium <= 2.5% of the ATM leg premium
Opening seed wings about 2,000 points out (SENSEX 4,000 before 16 Sep)
Every overnight book has long >= short on each right: defined risk overnight (31/31)
Protection costs money: real logs -₹8.4 lakh gross on longs; in the simulator wings, lump and hedge lower the mean
Per-lot stop near 1.55-1.6x entry, one lot at a time (D-1); weak on D0
Cycle stop near ₹1.42 lakh on cumulative D-1+D0 MTM; the client 4% / 1% rules do not match behaviour
Momentum-following rebalancing: 68.6% of body orders add delta in the direction of the last 5-min move; no forecasting skill (corr -0.007 / +0.025)
Exit: late closures in the 15:14 minute (9/10)
Real 32 cycles: gross +₹18.9 lakh; short calls +₹36.2 lakh, short puts -₹8.9 lakh, longs -₹8.4 lakh; model: time +₹87.6 lakh, direction -₹59.0 lakh, IV -₹19.2 lakh
Real logs: no demonstrated alpha vs a frozen opening basket; net depends on costs and two winners; overnight phase +₹5.2 lakh gross
3-year simulation: OOS ₹0.56 lakh per cycle net, t = 1.28; costs take ~51% of gross
Simulator: premium decay exceeds gamma loss by ~₹79k per cycle; 85% of holding P&L from short lots on D0
No seasonal or regime dependence of the weekly result
Index momentum has no skill at 15/30/60 min; volatility persistence is the only strong structure
Realised / implied variance < 1 on D-1, overnight and D0 (T1)
Short ATM straddle mean P&L positive in each segment, intervals include zero (T1)
Expiry-day 15-minute decay is ~9x the D-1 rate and accelerates after 14:00 (T2)
After the ladder trigger (new 60-min extreme) the index reverts, not continues (T3)
The ladder sale reduces |book delta| at 74% of triggers; the opposite sale almost never (T6)
Spreading sales over the 15-min clock does not lower the dispersion of a held-to-expiry carry (T5)
Short call vs short put: no reliable difference over 3 years (T4)
